projects.name: Kali Gandaki Rafting Corridor
projects.ward: Corridor wards: Balewa put-in (Ward 13) → Ramrekha take-out (near Ward 1); homestay line in Wards 10, 13, 14
projects.location: Kali Gandaki gorge, ~25 km grade 2–3 reach from Balewa (Ward 13) to Ramrekha (Ward 1) — v3 Ch7.1
projects.description: From v3 Ch7.1 + For addition.docx Ch7.1 — verified text
projects.rationale: Proven rafting reach with no river infrastructure; Nepal rafting market ~30,000–40,000 trips/yr; day visitors leave without staying or paying (v3 Ch5.5/7.1)
projects.objective: Turn the river into a revenue asset — 3,000 rafters/yr (yr 1) → 8,000/yr (yr 5); municipal take ~NPR 0.5–0.7 cr/yr at build-out
projects.strategy: 10-yr concession on municipal land: public ramps via municipal grant (7.00 cr), operator fleet (equity 3.90 / loan 9.10), certified-guide line (40 guides), booking + river-gauge + flood-stop rule, shuttle + homestay link
projects.priority: Flagship A — screened to sub-project level (v3 Ch7.1); viable as a package: concession IRR 7.9% (below 12% hurdle), fiscal flow ~NPR 0.65 cr/yr at build-out
projects.cost_estimate_npr: 20.00 cr project capital — municipal grant 7.00 (35%) + operator 13.00 (equity 3.90 / bank loan 9.10); year-by-year public line 4.50 (P3 package)
projects.cost_provenance: v3 Table 7.1 (20.00 cr unit-rate total) + Table 7.2 financing split; Financial doc T12 R04 for the 4.50 public concession package
projects.funding_source: Municipal grant 7.00 cr (public ramps/works, grant no repayment) · operator equity 3.90 (19.5%) · operator bank loan 9.10 (45.5%, 10%, 8-yr equal principal) — v3 Table 7.2
projects.implementing_agency: Municipality (tourism/engineering) holds ramps + safety standard; licensed private operator under 10-yr concession; Nepal Rafting Association–certified local guides
projects.outcome: 3,000–8,000 rafters/yr; municipal fiscal flow ~NPR 0.65 cr/yr at build-out; 40 certified local guides; homestay nights in Wards 10/13/14 tracked as community share
projects.risk: Flood (gauge + flow rule, take-out above flood line), safety (certification, life-jacket regime, emergency response), seasonality (bundled with heritage/agro circuit), river competition (price below Trisuli, gorge as differentiator)
projects.source: v3 Ch7.1 (concept, cost, revenue, delivery, appraisal) + Tables 7.1–7.2; Financial doc Ch6 (T12 R04 for public package)
